field_metadata.name: asdm_uid
field_metadata.description: UID of the ASDM containing this Field.

field_metadata.name: frequency
field_metadata.description: Observed (tuned) reference frequency on the sky.

field_metadata.name: frequency_support
field_metadata.description: All frequency ranges used by the field

field_metadata.name: spatial_resolution
field_metadata.description: Average of the maximum and minimum spatial resolution values of all spectral windows

field_metadata.name: sensitivity_10kms
field_metadata.description: Estimated noise in an nominal 10km/s bandwidth. Note this is an indication only, it does not include the effects of flagging or Hanning smoothing, and a 10km/s bandwidth may not be achievable with the data as taken.

field_metadata.name: cont_sensitivity_bandwidth
field_metadata.description: Estimated noise in the aggregated continuum bandwidth. Note this is an indication only, it does not include the effects of flagging or dynamic range limitations.

provenance.count_adql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_matches
FROM ivoa.obscore
WHERE member_ous_uid = 'uid://A001/X133d/X9c5'
    AND target_name = 'NGC253'
    AND science_observation = 'T'
provenance.retrieval_adql:
SELECT
    proposal_id,
    obs_publisher_did,
    group_ous_uid,
    member_ous_uid,
    asdm_uid,
    obs_id,
    target_name,
    s_ra,
    s_dec,
    s_region,
    frequency,
    bandwidth,
    em_xel,
    frequency_support,
    spectral_resolution,
    spatial_resolution,
    sensitivity_10kms,
